crossRefs.note: Absalom set Amasa over the army instead of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Ithra the Israelite, who…
Say to Amasa, ‘Aren’t you my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if you aren’t captain of the army…
Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

people.name: Amasa
people.line: Military commander, son of Abigail (David's sister), killed by Joab

translations.web: Then the king said to Amasa, “Call me the men of Judah together within three days, and be here present.”
translations.bsb: Then the king said to Amasa, “Summon the men of Judah to come to me within three days, and be here yourself.”
translations.kjv: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.
translations.asv: Then said the king to Amasa, Call me the men of Judah together within three days, and be thou here present.
